A possible Roman lead curse tablet (AD 43-AD 410). This rolled strip has been deliberately folded three times. It has linear indentations on the outer face and both sides. These may have been caused by a tool while folding rather than being decoration. Although this object has been classified as a curse tablet, it is possibly more modern and may have performed an entirely different function,…
